verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a UI library, so the axis applies. The pack does not document a deprecation policy or any API versioning guarantees. The only version references are React Compiler's compatibility with React 17, 18 and 19, which is an adjacent compatibility note, not a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
